conclusion: The original Anexo I LC 1.413/2024 reconciles 106 CCESP and 580.00 cotas only by level. The independently reconciled later source Deliberação ARTESP 722/2026 contains 134 numeric position rows representing 154 CCESP and 580.00 cotas. These are distinct versions; no allocation of 106 to named units was invented.

specialRegime.finding: LC 1.413 art. 70 and Decreto 69.339 art. 39 apply LC 1.395 to agency commission posts except Diretor-Presidente and Diretor. Do not count the separate agency directors or permanent jobs as the 106/154 commission-post allocation.

LC 1.395 art. 5 §3 assigns recomposition to the agency Conselho Diretor; art. 5 caput requires vacant posts, no expense increase and service continuity. The 106 original posts are not an immutable ceiling on the quantity after a documented recomposition.

Decreto 69.339 art. 42 expressly requires council allocation by organs/units, taking Anexo I LC1.413 quantities/unit and total values into account, subject to council recomposition. Art. 44 and Anexo Único contain agency-specific post denominations/levels.

Decreto 69.339 art. 39 sole paragraph specifically references Decreto68.742 art.4 and arts.6,7,9,11,12,14. Do not copy every ordinary secretariat hierarchy/cargo rule to ARTESP without checking the special regime.
